title: Demand Service Rate Programs: Working Out the Credit for a Missed Response
content:
The credit for a missed response is worked out from the charges the call it arises from carries and the
tier's credit rate. The call the credit arises from is the call last completed on the rate program. The
labor element is the hours the ticket logs for that call valued at the tier's block hour rate. The
attendance element is the tier's trip charge. The tier's credit rate applies. No uplift is applied for
earlier missed responses, the uplift standing at 1.0. The current program year runs from the day the
current term started to the day the credit is issued. The credit is the labor element and the attendance
element added together, taken at the credit rate for each hundred, multiplied by the uplift, rounded to
the nearest cent, half up, and it is never more than the tier's ceiling for one missed response. The
ceiling is compared with the rounded figure, so the ceiling applies last of all.

The block hour rate, the trip charge, the credit rate and the ceiling for one missed response are the
figures published for the program the account holds under the Demand Service Rate Programs.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

Take a rate program whose block hour rate is 132 US dollars an hour, whose trip charge is 85 US dollars,
whose credit rate is 25 percent and whose ceiling for one missed response is 750 US dollars. The ticket
of the call last completed logs 4.0 hours, so the labor element is 4.0 hours valued at 132 US dollars an
hour, which is 528 US dollars. The attendance element is the trip charge of 85 US dollars. The two added
together are 613 US dollars; taken at 25 for each hundred that is 153.25 US dollars, and multiplied by
the uplift of 1.0 it stands at 153.25 US dollars. Rounded to the nearest cent, half up, the figure is
153.25 US dollars, which is below the ceiling of 750 US dollars and is therefore the credit.

Where the same call had logged 25.0 hours, the two elements added would be 3385 US dollars, the credit
before the ceiling 846.25 US dollars, and the credit paid the ceiling of 750 US dollars, the ceiling
being compared with the rounded figure and applying last of all.
